title: GraphQL Mutation Testing — Runnable Companion
title_es: Testing de Mutaciones GraphQL — Companion Ejecutable
description: pytest 8.3 suite and a stdlib mock GraphQL server for the 10 mutation test cases from qapractices.com: create/update/delete lifecycle, batch partial failure, authorization codes, error unions, idempotency-key replay and optimistic concurrency.
description_es: Suite de pytest 8.3 y un mock GraphQL stdlib para los 10 casos de mutación de qapractices.com: ciclo crear/actualizar/eliminar, fallo parcial en batch, códigos de autorización, unions de error, reintento con idempotency key y concurrencia optimista.
